facts.fact: 生物课按姓氏字母配对解剖青蛙——Fletcher 排在 Morgan 前面，Milo 与 Max 被锁成搭档。
facts.anchor: pair up alphabetically, starting with A, B, and so on.

facts.fact: Sydney Pinkham 趁老师不备对 Sienna 比口型骂恐同蔑称，Delaney 叫她 Heartless——Sienna 竖中指回击面不改色。
facts.anchor: mouths a homophobic slur, making sure Ms. Mallory isn’t looking.

facts.fact: Misty 抱怨想跟 Max 一组，Milo 以「规则如此」拒绝，并补一句：就算能自选，我的选择也永远是 Max。
facts.anchor: “Besides, if I could pick anyone, I’d still choose Max. She’s always my pick.”

facts.fact: Jalen Carter 当众羞辱 Milo（校队夹克=学渣刻板印象），Max 反驳「那是可笑的偏见」，Milo 笑容尽失。
facts.anchor: “You’re just going to drag her grade down if you insist on being her lab partner.”

facts.fact: 争执平息后 Max 反手安抚，Milo 十指相扣、拇指画圈——牵手成了两人从未有过的最亲密时刻。
facts.anchor: his thumb begins drawing slow circles over mine.

facts.fact: 整堂课 Milo 一反常态地认真记笔记：他不在乎绩点，在乎 Max 的绩点——用行动兑现承诺。
facts.anchor: Then it hits me—he’s making good on his promise and proving Jalen wrong.

facts.fact: Milo 亲自把笔记送到 Cushman 餐馆找她，还打算请 Kody 的妈妈让她早点下班；他自己宣布「It's a date」。
facts.anchor: “I’d rather stop by the diner myself, if that’s okay.

facts.fact: 放学堵截：Peyton 令 Max 与 Jordan 换组——理由是 Milo 不能跟「垃圾」混在一起，有形象要维护。
facts.anchor: “Because I don’t want him associated with trash.”

facts.fact: Delaney 把 Max 推撞进储物柜，笑着宣告「讲道理没用就动手」。
facts.anchor: “Sometimes when words don’t work,” Delaney says with a smile, slow and ugly just like Peyton’s, “actions do.”

facts.fact: Peyton 凑近耳语下第二次警告：离 Milo 远点——眼神空无一物，「不会有第三次」。
facts.anchor: “Consider this your second warning.” She tilts her head ever so slightly, a thin smile settling across her lips. “You won’t get a third.”
